total_rate_certificate.E0_strengths: rho_j^2=T_j(E0)/Omega_e,total >=0; Omega has s^-1 units and rho^2 is dimensionless
total_rate_certificate.rate_difference: T_a(E0)-T_b(E0)=lambda_gamma*(kappa_b-kappa_a); E0 rates differ only if the ordinary total kappas differ
total_rate_certificate.photon_fraction_per_level_decay: lambda_gamma*tau_total=1/(1+alpha_obs), the same in both completed models
total_rate_certificate.gamma_shape_unchanged: E0 adds no single-photon amplitude; the already equal normalized W/Delta and common gamma scale remain unchanged in this fixed-population model
total_rate_certificate.measurement_consistency: If an independently known lambda_gamma and measured tau do not satisfy tau^-1=lambda_gamma*(1+alpha_obs), neither completion fits under the no-extra-channel inventory. If lambda_gamma is inferred from tau and alpha_obs, it is not a new independent input.

denominator_and_reference_boundaries.lambda_gamma_zero: Integrated electron/gamma ICC and normalized photon observables are undefined. E0 electron decay may still exist; the finite-alpha completion formula must not be used to exclude it.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.radiative_strength_zero: If S=0 there is no retained photon amplitude or normalized W/Delta; the inherited U pair has S=205/144>0.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.Omega_e_total_zero: No electron E0 rate can be generated from rho^2 in the stipulated model. Both alternatives then need alpha_obs=kappa_a=kappa_b; eta_s is undefined. Pair channels remain excluded.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.alpha_obs_zero: Only zero ordinary conversion and zero E0 are compatible; electron-shell/total ratios are undefined because the total electron denominator is zero.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.zero_shell_denominator: A shell-to-shell ratio requires both comparison denominators positive; zero/closed shell data need a rate/limit likelihood, not formal division.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.E0_partial_vs_total_lifetime: KB08 tau(E0) in Eq6 is the E0 partial mean life, not the total level tau used above.
denominator_and_reference_boundaries.no_pure_alpha_E0: There is no ordinary pure-E0 electron/single-gamma ICC because E0 has no single-photon denominator.

shell_certificate.eta: eta_s=Omega_s/Omega_e,total>=0, sum_s eta_s=1; Omega_e,total here excludes Omega_pair
shell_certificate.sum_rule: sum_s d_s=0 after matching the total
shell_certificate.one_shell_total_condition: For alpha_obs>0, h_s^(a)-h_s^(b)=d_s/alpha_obs. A nonzero known contrast can separate this pair if measured and theoretical uncertainties resolve it; d_s=0 provides no separation in that shell.
shell_certificate.two_shell_vector_condition: Measuring two partial shell/total fractions tests (d_s,d_t). At least one nonzero resolved component can reject a member; two zeros do not establish that all unmeasured shells coincide.
shell_certificate.two_shell_ratio_only_condition: alpha_s^(a)/alpha_t^(a)-alpha_s^(b)/alpha_t^(b)=[d_s alpha_t^(b)-d_t alpha_s^(b)]/[alpha_t^(a)alpha_t^(b)]. A shell-to-shell ratio alone can be blind even when individual shell/total fractions differ.
shell_certificate.all_shell_nondiscrimination: All shells remain equal iff delta_kappa_s=eta_s*delta_kappa_total for every shell; the ordinary-conversion difference then has the E0 shell pattern.
shell_certificate.purely_symbolic_control: alpha_s,L=eta_s*A_L is an algebraic example of that nondiscriminating condition. It is not an assigned atomic table or a claim that real coefficients have this factorization.
shell_certificate.theory_dependency: alpha_s,L and eta_s must be fixed consistently from the common atomic model, with uncertainties. Estimating eta_s by forcing the same shell counts is circular.

information_and_covariance.independent_ratio_rank: Three shell groups give rank3 ratio information: total alpha plus two shell-shape contrasts. The 3x3 minor is -N_rest/[N_gamma^2*N_e^2]. The two partial ICCs are derived alpha_obs*h_s and alpha_obs*h_t, not two further independent constraints.
information_and_covariance.two_shell_only_rank: If only two electron shells/groups exist, h_s+h_t=1 and the corresponding ratio Jacobian has rank2: one total ICC plus one independent shell-shape contrast.
information_and_covariance.general_propagation: Sigma_ratios=J_counts*Sigma_counts*J_counts^T. Include common gamma normalization, total-electron normalization, response/efficiency, background and theoretical alpha/Omega correlations; repeated ratios from one event sample are not independent experiments.

ideal_Poisson_controls.assumption: Only an illustrative first-order model of disjoint independent raw Poisson count means, not actual corrected data.
ideal_Poisson_controls.Cov_partial_alpha_s_alpha_t: N_s*N_t/N_gamma^3 from the common photon denominator
ideal_Poisson_controls.Cov_total_alpha_hs: 0 in this special ideal model; shared counts do not justify asserting every covariance is necessarily nonzero

information_and_covariance.useful_information_despite_shared_statis: Shell partitioning can add genuine information even within the same electron sample; its likelihood must use the joint covariance or primitive counts. It is not an independent replication.
information_and_covariance.near_zero_boundary: First-order ratio covariance requires nonzero denominators and adequate count likelihoods; do not assign zero uncertainty from absent/zero counts.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded Day8 L2 gamma/ICC/mean-lifetime E0-completion certificate.

Atomic coefficients, electronic factors, rates and count means remain symbolic.
No Z/E/nuclide transfer, atomic lookup, fit, microscopic-realizability claim,
new course card or L4. The default checks only; writing is exclusive creation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DEPS=ROOT/'tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/python-deps'
sys.path.insert(0,str(DEPS))
import sympy as sp

RUN=ROOT/'outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01'
PAIR=RUN/'four-multipole-fixed-population-pair.json'
OUT=RUN/'gamma-icc-lifetime-e0-completion.json'
LABELS=('M1','E2','M3','E4')


def matrix_strings(matrix):
    return [[sp.sstr(value) for value in row] for row in matrix.tolist()]


def build():
    started=time.monotonic()
    pair_bytes=PAIR.read_bytes()
    pair=json.loads(pair_bytes.decode('utf-8'))
    f_a=sp.Matrix([sp.sympify(pair['exact_pair']['radiative_fractions_a'][label]) for label in LABELS])
    f_b=sp.Matrix([sp.sympify(pair['exact_pair']['radiative_fractions_b'][label]) for label in LABELS])
    lam=sp.symbols('lambda_gamma',positive=True)
    alpha_obs,k_a,k_b=sp.symbols('alpha_obs kappa_a kappa_b',nonnegative=True)
    omega_total=sp.symbols('Omega_e_total',positive=True)
    atomic_tot=sp.Matrix(sp.symbols('alpha_tot_M1 alpha_tot_E2 alpha_tot_M3 alpha_tot_E4',nonnegative=True))
    kappa_a=sp.factor((f_a.T*atomic_tot)[0])
    kappa_b=sp.factor((f_b.T*atomic_tot)[0])
    e0_a=lam*(alpha_obs-k_a)
    e0_b=lam*(alpha_obs-k_b)
    rho2_a=e0_a/omega_total
    rho2_b=e0_b/omega_total
    checks={}

    def check(name,condition):
        checks[name]=bool(condition)
        if not checks[name]: raise AssertionError(name)

    check('U_pair_prior_certificate_success',pair['status']=='success_exact_full_support_fraction_changing_pair' and pair['checks']['failures']==0)
    check('gamma_scale_same',pair['exact_pair']['S_a']==pair['exact_pair']['S_b'])
    check('gamma_shape_prior_residuals_exact_zero',pair['exact_pair']['full_coefficient_residuals']==['0','0','0','0'])
    check('fractions_normalized',sp.simplify(sum(f_a)-1)==0 and sp.simplify(sum(f_b)-1)==0)
    check('fractions_distinct',f_a!=f_b)
    check('each_completed_total_ICC_a',sp.simplify((lam*k_a+e0_a)/lam-alpha_obs)==0)
    check('each_completed_total_ICC_b',sp.simplify((lam*k_b+e0_b)/lam-alpha_obs)==0)
    check('same_total_decay_rate_a',sp.simplify(lam+lam*k_a+e0_a-lam*(1+alpha_obs))==0)
    check('same_total_decay_rate_b',sp.simplify(lam+lam*k_b+e0_b-lam*(1+alpha_obs))==0)
    check('E0_rate_difference',sp.simplify(e0_a-e0_b-lam*(k_b-k_a))==0)
    check('E0_nuclear_electronic_factorization_a',sp.simplify(omega_total*rho2_a-e0_a)==0)
    check('E0_nuclear_electronic_factorization_b',sp.simplify(omega_total*rho2_b-e0_b)==0)
    check('decay_inventory_fraction_closure_a',sp.simplify((1+k_a+alpha_obs-k_a)/(1+alpha_obs)-1)==0)
    check('decay_inventory_fraction_closure_b',sp.simplify((1+k_b+alpha_obs-k_b)/(1+alpha_obs)-1)==0)
    # Exhaust the two possible orderings symbolically, rather than assigning ICC numbers.
    k0,d,x=sp.symbols('k0 d x',nonnegative=True)
    xp,epsilon=sp.symbols('x_positive epsilon',positive=True)
    for name,lo,hi in [('a_low',k0,k0+d),('b_low',k0+d,k0)]:
        aa=k0+d+x
        ta=sp.factor(lam*(aa-lo));tb=sp.factor(lam*(aa-hi))
        check(f'{name}_E0_nonnegative_a',ta.is_nonnegative is True)
        check(f'{name}_E0_nonnegative_b',tb.is_nonnegative is True)
    check('strict_above_max_both_rates_positive', (lam*xp).is_positive is True and (lam*(d+xp)).is_positive is True)
    check('endpoint_high_kappa_E0_zero',sp.simplify(lam*((k0+d)-(k0+d)))==0)
    check('below_high_kappa_requires_negative_E0',(-lam*epsilon).is_negative is True)
    check('equal_kappa_equal_E0_rates',sp.simplify((e0_a-e0_b).subs(k_b,k_a))==0)
    common_alpha=sp.symbols('common_atomic_coefficient',nonnegative=True)
    check('equal_pure_coefficients_give_equal_kappa',sp.simplify((kappa_b-kappa_a).subs(dict(zip(atomic_tot,[common_alpha]*4))))==0)

    # LKH82/KB08 two-gamma expression is an exact limiting form of the rate inventory.
    t,q2,a_m1,a_e2=sp.symbols('t q2 alpha_M1 alpha_E2',nonnegative=True)
    ordinary=(a_m1+t*a_e2)/(1+t)
    e0_k_relative=t*q2*a_e2/(1+t)
    source_mixed=(a_m1+t*(1+q2)*a_e2)/(1+t)
    check('source_K_shell_M1_E2_E0_relation_recovered',sp.simplify(ordinary+e0_k_relative-source_mixed)==0)

    eta_s,eta_t=sp.symbols('eta_s eta_t',nonnegative=True)
    eta_r=1-eta_s-eta_t
    kas,kbs,kat,kbt=sp.symbols('kappa_s_a kappa_s_b kappa_t_a kappa_t_b',nonnegative=True)
    completed_s_a=kas+eta_s*(alpha_obs-k_a)
    completed_s_b=kbs+eta_s*(alpha_obs-k_b)
    completed_t_a=kat+eta_t*(alpha_obs-k_a)
    completed_t_b=kbt+eta_t*(alpha_obs-k_b)
    difference_s=eta_s*(k_b-k_a)-(kbs-kas)
    difference_t=eta_t*(k_b-k_a)-(kbt-kat)
    check('shell_difference_s',sp.simplify(completed_s_a-completed_s_b-difference_s)==0)
    check('shell_difference_t',sp.simplify(completed_t_a-completed_t_b-difference_t)==0)
    check('shell_total_fraction_difference',sp.simplify(completed_s_a/alpha_obs-completed_s_b/alpha_obs-difference_s/alpha_obs)==0)
    check('shell_shell_ratio_discrimination_determinant',sp.simplify(completed_s_a/completed_t_a-completed_s_b/completed_t_b
          -(difference_s*completed_t_b-difference_t*completed_s_b)/(completed_t_a*completed_t_b))==0)

    # Three symbolic shell groups stand for s,t,and all remaining shells; no real shell values.
    shell_alpha=sp.Matrix(3,4,lambda i,j:sp.symbols(f'alpha_group{i}_{LABELS[j]}',nonnegative=True))
    eta=sp.Matrix([eta_s,eta_t,eta_r])
    k_shell_a=shell_alpha*f_a
    k_shell_b=shell_alpha*f_b
    k_total_a=sum(k_shell_a)
    k_total_b=sum(k_shell_b)
    d_shell=eta*(k_total_b-k_total_a)-(k_shell_b-k_shell_a)
    check('shell_contrasts_sum_zero',sp.simplify(sum(d_shell))==0)
    comp_shell_a=k_shell_a+eta*(alpha_obs-k_total_a)
    comp_shell_b=k_shell_b+eta*(alpha_obs-k_total_b)
    check('completed_shell_inventory_a_sums_total',sp.simplify(sum(comp_shell_a)-alpha_obs)==0)
    check('completed_shell_inventory_b_sums_total',sp.simplify(sum(comp_shell_b)-alpha_obs)==0)
    # A purely symbolic nondiscriminating pattern, not a claim about atomic tables.
    factorized={shell_alpha[i,j]:eta[i]*atomic_tot[j] for i in range(3) for j in range(4)}
    check('factorized_shell_pattern_can_leave_all_shells_degenerate',all(sp.simplify(value.subs(factorized))==0 for value in d_shell))
    check('closed_selected_shell_has_no_E0_contribution',sp.simplify(completed_s_a.subs(eta_s,0)-kas)==0)

    # Shared counts: show the information rank and the correlations without data or count values.
    ng,ns,nt,nr=sp.symbols('N_gamma N_s N_t N_rest',positive=True)
    ne=ns+nt+nr
    outputs=sp.Matrix([ne/ng,ns/ne,nt/ne,ns/ng,nt/ng])
    counts=sp.Matrix([ng,ns,nt,nr])
    jac=outputs.jacobian(counts)
    minor=sp.factor(jac[:3,:3].det())
    check('three_group_count_ratio_minor',sp.simplify(minor+nr/(ng**2*ne**2))==0)
    check('overall_count_scale_null_direction',(jac*counts).applyfunc(sp.simplify)==sp.zeros(5,1))
    check('partial_s_ratio_is_derived_product',sp.simplify(outputs[3]-outputs[0]*outputs[1])==0)
    check('partial_t_ratio_is_derived_product',sp.simplify(outputs[4]-outputs[0]*outputs[2])==0)
    check('partial_s_Jacobian_is_derived_row',(jac[3,:]-outputs[1]*jac[0,:]-outputs[0]*jac[1,:]).applyfunc(sp.simplify)==sp.zeros(1,4))
    check('partial_t_Jacobian_is_derived_row',(jac[4,:]-outputs[2]*jac[0,:]-outputs[0]*jac[2,:]).applyfunc(sp.simplify)==sp.zeros(1,4))
    poisson_cov=(jac*sp.diag(ng,ns,nt,nr)*jac.T).applyfunc(sp.factor)
    check('ideal_Poisson_shell_fraction_covariance',sp.simplify(poisson_cov[1,2]+ns*nt/ne**3)==0)
    check('ideal_Poisson_partial_ICCs_share_gamma_denominator',sp.simplify(poisson_cov[3,4]-ns*nt/ng**3)==0)
    check('ideal_Poisson_total_ICC_shell_fraction_cross_cov_can_vanish',poisson_cov[0,1]==poisson_cov[0,2]==0)
    two_shell_outputs=outputs.subs(nr,0)
    two_shell_jac=two_shell_outputs.jacobian((ng,ns,nt))
    check('two_shell_fraction_closure',sp.simplify(two_shell_outputs[1]+two_shell_outputs[2]-1)==0)
    check('two_shell_information_rank2',two_shell_jac.rank()==2)
    check('U_pair_input_unchanged',PAIR.read_bytes()==pair_bytes)
    raw_files={
        'LKH82':('raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/review/1982_Lange et al_E0-E2-M1 multipole admixtures of transitions in even-even nuclei.pdf','ed925a0577a9257903806acd209c1db707529e86a5bfd9a301a83d597bf78ffb'),
        'KB08':('raw/papers/2008_Kibédi et al_Evaluation of theoretical conversion coefficients using BrIcc.pdf','5a7b25491864acd4d2fea7a599136657da336a03f902009b423c6c450926cc34')}
    hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,(path,expected) in raw_files.items()}
    for name,(path,expected) in raw_files.items(): check(f'{name}_raw_identity',hashes[name]==expected)
    code=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    return {
        'schema_version':1,'created_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'artifact_kind':'bounded-Day8-L2-gamma-ICC-lifetime-E0-completion',
        'status':'symbolic_rate_completion_proved_shell_discrimination_conditional',
